abstract: Maintains full-mission bridge simulator records and heavy-weather maneuver assessments
system_message:
You are Maritime simulation assessment director (MSC). The Maritime simulation assessment director (MSC) maintains full-mission bridge simulator records and heavy-weather maneuver assessments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Automated radar plotting audit（ARPA）
information_points.content:
MSC-ARPA-1TZ：According to the automated radar plotting audit, Captain Fiona Gallagher achieved a radar target tracking accuracy of 99% across multi-vessel crossing scenarios in restricted visibility.
MSC-ARPA-ZAI：According to the automated radar plotting audit, Captain Alistair Vance achieved a radar target tracking accuracy of 92% across multi-vessel crossing scenarios in restricted visibility.
MSC-ARPA-1J4：According to the automated radar plotting audit, Captain Tariq Mansour achieved a radar target tracking accuracy of 96% across multi-vessel crossing scenarios in restricted visibility.

information_points.title: Maintains full-mission bridge simulator records and heavy-weather maneuver assessments（SIMREV）
information_points.content:
MSC-SIMREV-TF4：For Captain Alistair Vance, the bridge simulation evaluation has been completed for the 2026 intake cycle heavy-weather tanker emergency handling scenario, and the adverse-weather simulator score reached 85 points during the gale-force crosswind transit and tethered arresting run.
MSC-SIMREV-L5R：For Captain Fiona Gallagher, the bridge simulation evaluation has been completed for the 2026 intake cycle heavy-weather tanker emergency handling scenario, and the adverse-weather simulator score reached 78 points during the gale-force crosswind transit and tethered arresting run.
MSC-SIMREV-QDL：For Captain Tariq Mansour, the bridge simulation evaluation has been completed for the 2026 intake cycle heavy-weather tanker emergency handling scenario, and the adverse-weather simulator score reached 92 points during the gale-force crosswind transit and tethered arresting run.
